stories.title: UNC upsets TCU to open year two under Belichick
stories.summary: New quarterback Billy Edwards Jr. threw for 232 yards as North Carolina opened coach Bill Belichick's second season with a 15-10 win over TCU on a rainy Saturday in Ireland.

stories.title: Dolphins ship QB Ewers to Jaguars for draft pick
stories.summary: On Saturday, the Jacksonville Jaguars traded for quarterback Quinn Ewers, 23, who played in four games last season and completed 66.3% of his passes, sending a sixth-round pick in 2028 to the Miami Dolphins for the second-year player, the teams announced.

stories.title: Meyer propels Nevada into LLBWS title game
stories.summary: Carsynn Meyer, the first girl to play in the U.S. championship, had an RBI single to help Nevada beat Ohio on Saturday and advance to the Little League World Baseball Series title game.

stories.title: PCA hits three HRs after Sosa's homer challenge
stories.summary: Cubs star Pete Crow-Armstrong bolstered his case for NL MVP honors Saturday, slugging three home runs against the Reds at Wrigley Field in Chicago.

stories.title: Sources: Cowboys trade for Steelers OT Jones
stories.summary: The Steelers are sending 2023 first-round pick Broderick Jones and a fourth-round pick in 2027 to the Cowboys in exchange for a 2027 third- and sixth-round pick, sources told ESPN.
